prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I did this quick swing through Chongqing, and I remember killing time by checking what movies were on around town.
One afternoon I ended up watching The Wandering Earth 3, and the ticket was under Feng Jie—still have the stub somewhere.
It was at CGV Raffles City, and I’m pretty sure the showtime on it said 13:20.
I went alone that day too—seat_count was just 1—then later that trip I passed through Nanjing and kept chatting about restaurants there.
My coworker Li Na had organized a big lunch at Nanjing Impressions on 2025-03-18, and it was a whole crowd.
They showed up at 12:00, party_size was 10, and the contact phone on the booking was 13855667788—then afterward I was in Shanghai and just used car apps to get around.
